title: The CFPB is Correcting Flaws to Restore Integrity and Utility to the Consumer Complaint System
discussion_signal: The post discusses changes to authentication, dispute sequencing, and response categories intended to reduce duplicate or non-consumer submissions. It makes a central tradeoff visible: improving intake integrity may reduce public narrative visibility and change what complaint volume can mean.
linked_research_question: When a complaint system filters noise and improves response integrity, what consumer meaning or public visibility may be lost?
limits: The post reflects a professional interpretation of CFPB changes
Complaint volume is not a direct measure of consumer harm
The post cannot establish the downstream effect of the new filters
